title: America's Blood Types Are Far From Even
hook: Some blood types fill donor shelves while others barely appear.
closing: Blood supply depends on a diverse donor pool because type distribution is deeply uneven.
question: Do you know your blood type?

segments.say: Only 1% of Americans have AB-negative blood. The rarest type starts with a tiny donor pool.
Only 15% of Americans are Rh-negative. That factor makes every negative type harder to match.
O-positive reaches 53% among Latin American donors. Donor background changes which types enter the supply.
